parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
 'empresas', (SELECT json_agg(e ORDER BY e.id) FROM ixc.empresas e WHERE e.ativo),
 'tecnicos', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM ixc.tecnicos t),
 'locais', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(l), '[]'::json) FROM ixc.locais l),
 'funcionarios', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(f), '[]'::json) FROM ixc.funcionarios f),
 'param', (SELECT json_object_agg(chave, valor) FROM ixc.parametros),
 'pendentes', '[]'::json,
 'lembretes', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT empresa, id_chamado, tipo, evento FROM ixc.eventos WHERE tipo LIKE 'lembrete%' AND status = 'ok' AND ts > now() - interval '3 days') x)
) AS cfg

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ session: (typeof $('Carregar Config').first().json.cfg === 'string' ? JSON.parse($('Carregar Config').first().json.cfg) : $('Carregar Config').first().json.cfg).param.waha_session, chatId: $json.chat_envio || $json.grupo_jid, text: $json.texto, linkPreview: false }, ($json.mentioned && $json.mentioned.length) ? { mentions: $json.mentioned.map(f => String(f).replace(/\D/g, '') + '@c.us') } : {})) }}
